decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system fits the firm's specialist robust-lighting niche and has stayed on the website for two years, so results look satisfactory enough that management sees no reason to search for alternatives, and the large firm's slack lets it carry a long-cycle defence product.

The general interior luminaire moved from its own page to a simple mention, which hints at fading promotion, but it is core to the firm's established business and likely meets aspirations, so dropping it is unlikely.
The microprismatic pendant was actively promoted as a latest release in 2024, which signals performance at or above aspiration and continued strategic fit with efficient, ergonomic office lighting.

The firm already dropped the sibling HMI marine searchlight, which shows problemistic search in this line, but the remaining searchlight has survived and is probably the LED-aligned variant, so the firm keeps it for now with moderate risk.
